subject.title: feat(workshop): allow restoring rejected proposals back to pending

question: Should restore remain an operator-only CLI/UI/gateway action with current-state-only metadata, or should OpenClaw also expose it through the agent tool and retain durable lifecycle history?
rationale: The branch implements operator surfaces and clears rejection metadata, while the changed docs and linked issue imply broader model invocation and audit-history contracts that are not implemented.

options.title: Operator-only current state
options.body: Remove restore from the agent-tool documentation and explicitly accept that restoring clears the rejection timestamp and reason.

options.title: Agent action with history
options.body: Implement restore in the agent tool, approval policy, prompts, tests, and a durable lifecycle-event model.

options.title: Keep rejection terminal
options.body: Decline the new transition and retain proposal recreation as the supported recovery path.

recommendation.title: Operator-only current state
recommendation.body: Remove restore from the agent-tool documentation and explicitly accept that restoring clears the rejection timestamp and reason.

likelyOwner.reason: The Skill Workshop lifecycle, policy, gateway, agent tool, docs, and recent adjacent history most strongly route this product contract here.
